writeup: TIC 306294675 is an eclipsing binary candidate with an orbital period of 2.9822 days. The primary eclipse produces a 2.43% dimming, detected with a signal-to-noise ratio of 179.8 using the Box Least Squares method. A secondary eclipse was also detected at 5.6 sigma significance. Pixel-level analysis confirms the signal with a peak signal-to-noise of 24.7, though the centroid offset of 6.6 arcseconds from the target position warrants further investigation. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it potentially novel. Automated TESS photometry and image analysis flagged no data quality issues with this candidate.
